entities.summary: Borys Albertovych Filatov is a Ukrainian politician, journalist, lawyer, businessman, and the current mayor of Dnipro. In 2014 and 2015, he was a People's Deputy of Ukraine. He is one of the leaders and founders of the political party Proposition.
